RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.abs_probability_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.abs_probability_covariance_le_complement
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.abs_probability_.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop),
  |(RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A ω ∧ B ω) -

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.benchmark_lower_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.benchmark_lower_at_tau

        RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonBase * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ^ 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision μ

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_marginal.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_marginal_absolute
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_marginal.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (A : ℝ),
        0 < A ∧
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            ∀ N ≥ N0,
              ∀ (k K : ℕ),
                ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                  ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                    (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
                      ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w ≤ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →
                        |RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) -
                              RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w)| ≤

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_marginal.type: ∀ (N1 N2 N3 N : ℕ), 2 ≤ N → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_moment_t.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_moment_term_le
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_moment_t.type:
∀ {D C : ℝ},
  0 ≤ D →
    0 ≤ C →
      ∀ {N : ℕ},
        1 ≤ N →
          1 ≤ TimeProfile.logScale N →
            TimeProfile.logScale N ^ 3 ≤ ↑N ^ (1 / 50) →
              ∀ {μ ν : ℝ},
                0 ≤ μ →
                  0 ≤ ν →
                    μ + ν ≤ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →
                      RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError D C N * (1 + μ) * (1 + ν) * Real.exp (μ + ν) ≤
                        4 * D * (C + 1) * ↑N ^ (-7 / 10)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_pair_abs.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_pair_absolute
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.central_pair_abs.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),

      ∃ (A : ℝ),

            ∀ N ≥ N0,
              ∀ (k K : ℕ),
                ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                  ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w v : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                    w ≠ v →
                      (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →

                          ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev.type:

  0 < t →
    (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => t ≤ |f ω - RiffleLowerV2.expect P f|) ≤
      RiffleLowerV2.variance P f / t ^ 2

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_variance_le
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.chebyshev_of_var.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (η t : ℝ),
  0 < RiffleLowerV2.expect P f →
    0 < t →
      RiffleLowerV2.variance P f ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P f + η * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ^ 2 →
        (RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => t * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ≤ |f ω - RiffleLowerV2.expect P f|) ≤
          1 / (t ^ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f) + η / t ^ 2

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.collision_succes.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),

      ∃ (D : ℝ),
        0 < D ∧

                ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                  ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (W : Finset (RiffleLowerV2.Word k K)),

                      0 < RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W) →
                        1 - 4 / RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W) -

                            RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W) / 2 ≤

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditional_full.type:

                RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω - {q : Fin b | p.word q = w}.card < 2)
              (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) ≤

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditional_one_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditional_one_factorial_inputs
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.conditional_one_.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∀ (b0 : ℕ),
        ∃ (D : ℝ),
          0 < D ∧
            ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
              b0 < N0 ∧
                2 ≤ N0 ∧
                  ∀ N ≥ N0,
                    ∀ (k K b : ℕ),
                      b ≤ b0 →
                        ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                          ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
                            Function.Injective p.row →
                              0 <

                                    (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) →
                                ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),

                                                  RiffleLowerV2.falling
                                                    (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω - {q : Fin b | p.word q = w}.card) r)
                                                (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) -
                                              RiffleLowerV2.Targets.residualWordMean cuts p w ^ r| ≤

                                            RiffleLowerV2.Targets.residualWordMean cuts p w ^ r

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_central.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_central_error_bounds
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_central.type:
∀ (D C : ℝ),
  0 < D →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        ∀ N ≥ N0,
          (∀ (μ ν : ℝ),
              0 ≤ μ →
                μ ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →
                  0 ≤ ν →
                    ν ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →
                      RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError D C N * (1 + μ) * (1 + ν) * Real.exp (μ + ν) +
                          3 *
                            (RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) μ +
                                RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) ν +
                              RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) μ *
                                RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) ν) ≤
                        RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralConstant D C * ↑N ^ (-7 / 10)) ∧
            ∀ (t : ℝ),
              0 ≤ t →
                t ≤ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →
                  RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError D C N * (1 + t) * Real.exp t +
                      3 * RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) t ≤
                    RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralConstant D C * ↑N ^ (-7 / 10)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_central.type:
∀ (D C : ℝ),
  0 < D →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        ∀ N ≥ N0,
          2 ≤ N ∧
            1 ≤ TimeProfile.logScale N ∧
              2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N ∧
                Even (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) ∧
                  2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N ∧
                    ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N) ≤ ↑N ^ (1 / 5) ∧
                      ↑N ^ (1 / 25) / 4 ≤ ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) ∧
                        ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) ≤ ↑N ∧
                          3 * TimeProfile.logScale N ≤ ↑(RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N) * Real.log 2 ∧
                            TimeProfile.logScale N ^ 3 ≤ ↑N ^ (1 / 50) ∧
                              0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError D C N ∧
                                RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError D C N ≤ 1

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_margina.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_marginal_budgets
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_margina.type:
∀ (D C A : ℝ),
  ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
    ∀ N ≥ N0,
      2 ≤ N ∧
        10 ≤ TimeProfile.logScale N ∧
          RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
            9 * D * (C * TimeProfile.logScale N + 1) / ↑N ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ∧
              A * ↑N ^ (-7 / 10) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonBase * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ^ 3 ∧
                2 * Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N / 2) +
                      (1 + RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N) *
                        Real.exp (-RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N) ≤
                    RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N / 2 ∧

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_nonrare.type:
∀ (A : ℝ),
  ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
    ∀ N ≥ N0,
      2 ≤ N ∧
        RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ≤ 1 / 16 ∧
          2 * ↑N ^ (-1 / 20) ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
            A * ↑N ^ (-7 / 10) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonBase ^ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ^ 5 ∧
              2 * ↑N ^ (-1 / 20) ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonBase * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ^ 3 / 4

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_rare_pa.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_rare_pair_budgets
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_rare_pa.type:

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_residua.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_residual_budgets
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventual_residua.type:

    ∀ (b0 M0 : ℕ),
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        b0 < N0 ∧
          2 ≤ N0 ∧
            ∀ N ≥ N0,
              ∀ b ≤ b0,

                  2 ≤ N - b ∧

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.exists_residual_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.exists_residual_word_law
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.exists_residual_.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b),
  b < N →
    Function.Injective p.row →
      0 < RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) →
        ∃ (residual : TimeProfile.Cuts k (N - b) K),
          (∀ (j : Fin K) (a : Fin k), residual.count j a = cuts.count j a - RiffleLowerV2.usedCount p j a) ∧
            (∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (F : ℕ → ℝ),
                RiffleLowerV2.conditionalExpect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                    (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                      F (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω - {q : Fin b | p.word q = w}.card))
                    (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) =
                  RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF residual)
                    fun (η : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample residual) => F (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w η)) ∧
              (∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (A : ℕ → Prop),
                  RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                      (fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                        A (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω - {q : Fin b | p.word q = w}.card))
                      (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent p) =
                    RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF residual)
                      fun (η : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample residual) => A (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w η)) ∧
                ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                  ↑(N - b) * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass residual w = RiffleLowerV2.Targets.residualWordMean cuts p w

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.exp_logScale_mul.type: ∀ {N : ℕ}, 0 < N → ∀ (a : ℝ), Real.exp (TimeProfile.logScale N * a) = ↑N ^ a

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_eventCoun.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_eventCount
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_eventCoun.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (W : Finset ι) (A : ι → Ω → Prop),
  RiffleLowerV2.expect P (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A) = ∑ i ∈ W, RiffleLowerV2.probability P (A i)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_eventCoun.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_eventCount_sq
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_eventCoun.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (W : Finset ι) (A : ι → Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.eventCount W A ω ^ 2) =
    ∑ i ∈ W, ∑ j ∈ W, RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A i ω ∧ A j ω

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_indicator.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_indicator_mul
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.expect_indicator.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (A B : Ω → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect P fun (ω : Ω) => (if A ω then 1 else 0) * if B ω then 1 else 0) =
    RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => A ω ∧ B ω

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_eq_forci.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_eq_forcing_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_eq_forci.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} {cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K} (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (ω : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts),
  RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) b =
    ∑ e : Fin b ↪ Fin N,
      if RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e) ω then 1 else 0

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_expect_e.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_expect_eq_forcing_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_expect_e.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) b) =
    ∑ e : Fin b ↪ Fin N,
      RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
        (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e))

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_weighted_event_eq_forcing_sum
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.falling_weighted.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (A : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts → Prop),
  (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
      RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) b * if A ω then 1 else 0) =
    ∑ e : Fin b ↪ Fin N,
      RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
        A ω ∧ RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e) ω

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted_relative_error
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K) (A : RiffleLowerV2.Sample cuts → Prop)
  (δ : ℝ),
  (∀ (e : Fin b ↪ Fin N),
      0 <
        RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
          (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e))) →
    (∀ (e : Fin b ↪ Fin N),
        |RiffleLowerV2.conditionalProbability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) A
                (RiffleLowerV2.prescriptionEvent (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.sameWordPrescription w e)) -
              RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) A| ≤
          δ * RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) A) →
      |(RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
              RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) b * if A ω then 1 else 0) -
            (RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) b) *
              RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) A| ≤
        (δ *
            RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
              RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) b) *
          RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) A

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 2] [NeZero 2], (2 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted_relative_error._simp_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : Zero α] [inst_1 : OfNat α 4] [NeZero 4], (4 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted_relative_error._simp_1_4
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : Mul M₀] [inst_1 : Zero M₀] [NoZeroDivisors M₀] {a b : M₀}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a * b = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted_relative_error._simp_1_5
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type: ∀ {M₀ : Type u_1} [inst : MonoidWithZero M₀] {a : M₀} [IsReduced M₀] (n : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted_relative_error._simp_1_6
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type: ∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] {a : G₀} (n : ℤ), a ≠ 0 → (a ^ n = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.forcing_weighted.type: ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : AddMonoidWithOne R] [CharZero R] (n : ℕ), (↑n + 1 = 0) = False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.fullWord_empty_s.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.fullWord_empty_singleton_tail
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.fullWord_empty_s.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K),
  0 < N →
    ∀ (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
      (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
          RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω < 2) ≤
        2 * Real.exp (-(↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w) / 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.large_word_compl.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.large_word_complement
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.large_word_compl.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  0 < N →
    RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N < ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w →
      (RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
          ¬RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w ω) ≤
        2 * ↑N ^ (-1 / 20)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.large_word_compl.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.large_word_complement._simp_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.large_word_compl.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : LinearOrder α] {a b : α}, (¬a ≤ b) = (b < a)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_logScale_sub
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_.type: ∀ {N b : ℕ}, 2 ≤ N - b → ↑N ≤ 2 * ↑(N - b) → TimeProfile.logScale N ≤ 2 * TimeProfile.logScale (N - b)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_logScale_sub._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_.type: ∀ {N b : ℕ}, 2 ≤ N - b → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.logScale_le_two_.type: ∀ {N b : ℕ}, 2 ≤ N - b → ¬0 < N - b → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.log_affine_mul_r.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.log_affine_mul_rpow_tendsto
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.log_affine_mul_r.type: ∀ (a b r : ℝ), r < 0 → Filter.Tendsto (fun (N : ℕ) => (a * TimeProfile.logScale N + b) * ↑N ^ r) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.lower_tail_succe.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.lower_tail_success
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.lower_tail_succe.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (η t : ℝ),
  0 < RiffleLowerV2.expect P f →
    0 < t →
      RiffleLowerV2.variance P f ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P f + η * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ^ 2 →
        1 - 1 / (t ^ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f) - η / t ^ 2 ≤
          RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => (1 - t) * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f < f ω

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError_nonn.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError_nonneg
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError_nonn.type: ∀ {D C : ℝ}, 0 ≤ D → 0 ≤ C → ∀ {N : ℕ}, 1 ≤ N → 0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentError D C N

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_pair_rel.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_pair_relative
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_pair_rel.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
        2 ≤ N0 ∧
          ∀ N ≥ N0,
            ∀ (k K : ℕ),
              ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w v : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                  w ≠ v →
                    (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
                      (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get v j))) →
                        RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N < ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w →
                          RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N < ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts v →
                            |(RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                    fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                    RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w ω ∧ RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v ω) -
                                  RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                      (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) *
                                    RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                      (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v)| ≤
                              128 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N *
                                  RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                    (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) *
                                RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                  (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_pair_rel.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_pair_relative._proof_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_pair_rel.type: ∀ (N1 N2 N3 N : ℕ), 2 ≤ N → ¬0 < N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_probabil.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_probability_lower
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.nonrare_probabil.type:
∀ {N k K : ℕ} (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  0 < N →
    RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ≤ 1 / 16 →
      RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N < ↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w →
        |RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w) -
                RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w)| ≤
            8 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N * RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w) →
          RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonBase * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.tau N ^ 2 / 2 ≤
            RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent w)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.order_bounds._pr.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.order_bounds._proof_1_2
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.order_bounds._pr.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  10 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N →
    RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N < 4 * (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N / 4) + 4 →
      ¬2 ≤ 2 * (RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N / 4) → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.order_bounds._pr.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.order_bounds._proof_1_3
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.order_bounds._pr.type:
∀ {N : ℕ},
  2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N →
    ¬RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.bonferroniOrder N ≤ RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.momentRadius N → False

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.original_one_fac.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.original_one_factorial_inputs
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.original_one_fac.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (D : ℝ),
        0 < D ∧
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            ∀ N ≥ N0,
              ∀ (k K : ℕ),
                ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                  ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                    (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
                      ∀ (r : ℕ),
                        ↑r ≤ ↑N ^ (1 / 5) →
                          |(RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                  fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                  RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) r) -
                                (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w) ^ r| ≤
                            D * (↑K + 1) * ↑r ^ 2 / ↑N * (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w) ^ r

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.original_two_fac.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.original_two_factorial_inputs
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.original_two_fac.type:
∀ (c C : ℝ),
  0 < c →
    0 < C →
      ∃ (D : ℝ),
        0 < D ∧
          ∃ (N0 : ℕ),
            ∀ N ≥ N0,
              ∀ (k K : ℕ),
                ↑K ≤ C * TimeProfile.logScale N →
                  ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w v : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
                    w ≠ v →
                      (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get w j))) →
                        (∀ (j : Fin K), c * ↑N ≤ ↑(cuts.count j (List.Vector.get v j))) →
                          ∀ (r s : ℕ),
                            ↑(r + s) ≤ ↑N ^ (1 / 5) →
                              |(RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts)
                                      fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>
                                      RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount w ω) r *
                                        RiffleLowerV2.falling (RiffleLowerV2.wordCount v ω) s) -
                                    (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w) ^ r *
                                      (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts v) ^ s| ≤
                                D * (↑K + 1) * ↑(r + s) ^ 2 / ↑N *
                                  ((↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts w) ^ r * (↑N * RiffleLowerV2.wordMass cuts v) ^ s)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.pair_relative_of.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.pair_relative_of_benchmark
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.pair_relative_of.type:
∀ {p q joint f g ε δ : ℝ},
  0 ≤ f →
    0 ≤ g →
      0 ≤ ε →
        ε ≤ 1 / 2 →
          0 ≤ δ →
            |p - f| ≤ ε * f → |q - g| ≤ ε * g → |joint - f * g| ≤ δ * f * g → |joint - p * q| ≤ 4 * (δ + 3 * ε) * p * q

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision_elasticity
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.type:
∀ {t : ℝ},
  0 < t →
    0 ≤ t * deriv RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t / RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t ∧
      t * deriv RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t / RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t ≤ 2

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision_lower
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.type: ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → Real.exp (-t) * t ^ 2 / 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision_lower_min
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.type: ∀ (t : ℝ), 0 ≤ t → Real.exp (-1) / 2 * min (t ^ 2) 1 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision_rare
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.type:
∀ (t : ℝ),
  0 ≤ t → t ^ 2 / 2 - t ^ 3 / 2 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t ∧ RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision t ≤ t ^ 2 / 2

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision_scale_compare
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.type: ∀ {x y : ℝ}, 0 < x → x ≤ y → x ^ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision y ≤ y ^ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision x

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision_stability
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonCollision.type:
∀ {x y δ : ℝ},
  0 < x →
    0 < y →
      0 ≤ δ →
        δ ≤ 1 →
          |y - x| ≤ δ * x →
            |RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision y - RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision x| ≤
              3 * δ * RiffleLowerV2.poissonCollision x

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonRemainder.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonRemainder_exp_bound
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonRemainder.type: ∀ (m : ℕ) {t : ℝ}, 0 ≤ t → RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder m t ≤ ↑m * Real.exp (2 * t - ↑m * Real.log 2)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonRemainder.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonRemainder_le_inverse
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.poissonRemainder.type:
∀ {N m : ℕ},
  1 ≤ N →
    ↑m ≤ ↑N →
      3 * TimeProfile.logScale N ≤ ↑m * Real.log 2 →
        ∀ {t : ℝ},
          0 ≤ t →
            t ≤ 2 * RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.centralBound N →
              0 ≤ RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder m t ∧ RiffleLowerV2.poissonRemainder m t ≤ ↑N ^ (-1)

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.positive_success.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.positive_success
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.positive_success.type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype Ω] (P : PMF Ω) (f : Ω → ℝ) (η : ℝ),
  0 < RiffleLowerV2.expect P f →
    RiffleLowerV2.variance P f ≤ RiffleLowerV2.expect P f + η * RiffleLowerV2.expect P f ^ 2 →
      1 - 1 / RiffleLowerV2.expect P f - η ≤ RiffleLowerV2.probability P fun (ω : Ω) => 0 < f ω

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefix.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefixCount_fullPrefix
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefix.type:
∀ {N k K b : ℕ} (p : RiffleLowerV2.RowPrescription N k K b) (w : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),
  RiffleLowerV2.Thinning.prescribedPrefixCount p (RiffleLowerV2.fullPrefix w) = {q : Fin b | p.word q = w}.card

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefix.name: RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefixCount_fullPrefix._simp_1_1
RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.prescribedPrefix.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : α → Prop} [inst : DecidablePred p] {s : Finset α} {a : α}, (a ∈ Finset.filter p s) = (a ∈ s ∧ p a)

                ∀ (k K : ℕ),

                    ∀ (cuts : TimeProfile.Cuts k N K) (w v : RiffleLowerV2.Word k K),

RiffleLowerV2.Occupancy.variance_collisi.type:

  0 ≤ η →
    (∀ w ∈ W,
        ∀ v ∈ W,
          w ≠ v →
            |(RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) fun (ω : TimeProfile.ShuffleSample cuts) =>

                RiffleLowerV2.probability (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionEvent v)) →
      RiffleLowerV2.variance (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W) ≤
        RiffleLowerV2.expect (TimeProfile.fixedCountPMF cuts) (RiffleLowerV2.collisionCount W) +
